checks.exercise: Smith decline chest press with elbow extension and vertical guided bar
checks.equipment: Thirty-degree decline bench, foot platform and Smith rails
checks.setup: 스미스 머신 안에 디클라인 벤치를 놓고 머리가 낮아지도록 눕는다. 등과 머리를 받치고 양발을 지지대에 고정한 뒤 바를 어깨보다 넓게 잡는다.
checks.hands: Closed symmetric overhand grip fixed to bar
checks.feet: Fixed flat feet on elevated supported platform
checks.movement: 바를 가슴 아래쪽 앞으로 천천히 내린다. 팔꿈치를 펴며 수직으로 밀어 올린다.

limitations: Procedural demonstration, not captured human motion.
Bar stops approximately 0.11 model units above sampled torso surface; no chest bounce.
Bench entry/exit and rack unlocking omitted; sampled clearance, not exhaustive collision certification.
